author: Nerdstalgic
description:
How did a spin off of The Boys become one of the smartest superhero shows on television?

When Gen V was first announced, most fans assumed it would be another disposable spin-off designed to extend a popular franchise. Instead, Gen V managed to accomplish something incredibly rare, it expanded The Boys universe while creating an identity entirely its own.

By shifting the focus from superheroes at the top of the food chain to students desperately trying to survive a system built around branding, popularity, and corporate control, Gen V transformed the familiar world of The Boys into something even more unsettling.
title: How The Boys Created The Perfect Spin-Off
